testcase.name: a message that arrives while its run is backing off does not count as another failure()
a tenant with a large backlog cannot starve another tenant()
a run that only waits for an approval is polled at the slower approval interval()
sweep backoff of a repeatedly failing run is exponential with a floor and a cap()
oldest eligible run is served first and every run is examined within ceil(n over limit) passes()
a dead letter counts as one failure of its run and does not kill a healthy run()
the per-tenant cap bounds one tenant even when it is alone with a backlog()
a dead letter naming an unknown or foreign run is ignored()
a sweep over runs that all fail does not throw and leaves healthy ones for later passes()
the failure budget is explicit and a budget of one fails the run on the first poison message()
runs whose publish fails are backed off and do not hog the next passes()
a run is not examined again before the minimum interval and is again after it()
a poison run is retried with growing backoff and only its own message is dead-lettered()
